newsitem.title: UK: Aug Flotta loads 6.3 mln bbl from 5.4 mln - trade.
newsitem.headline: Aug Flotta loads 6.3 mln bbl from 5.4 mln - trade.

text.p: Britain's North Sea Flotta crude pipeline system has scheduled 11 cargoes to load in August totalling 6.3 million barrels, traders said on Wednesday.
The August programme compares with a revised July programme of 5.4 million barrels in nine cargoes.
The August cargoes comprise eight of 600,000 barrels and three of 500,000 barrels.
The first cargo loads August 3-5 and the last loads August 29-31, giving an estimated average daily flow of around 230,000 bpd.

One cargo loading July 20-22 was cancelled from the original July loading programme, cutting the schedule to nine cargoes totalling 5.4 million barrels from the original 10 cargoes with 5.8 million barrels.
